machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Provisioned dashboard "Service health" (found at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, displayed as "Service Health") has exactly three panels, titled as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**2. DONE** — New dashboard `fwgr63-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr63-n1 Availability`. Verified in the panel editor after reload: visualization picker reads "Stat", and the query data source is **TestData** (picker placeholder "TestData", TestData logo, current picker entry "TestData default TestData"; no Prometheus entry).

**3. DONE** — The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr63-n1 Notes`, whose rendered content is `Notes for run fwgr63-n1` (includes the runid). Confirmed present after a full page reload.

**4. DONE** — Dashboard tag is `bench` (verified via Settings → Tags after reload, showing the "bench" chip). Time range is `Last 6 hours` and it is persisted: the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox was confirmed unchecked in the DOM, ticked, then saved. Loading the plain URL with no query parameters still yields `Last 6 hours` (URL rewritten to `from=now-6h&to=now`), proving it was saved as the default rather than being session-only.

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval is `1m` and persisted. On this build the refresh interval is set via the top-bar auto-refresh button (not inside the time-picker dropdown); the save drawer's "Update default refresh value" checkbox was ticked before saving. After reloading the plain URL, the control reads `1m` (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected") and the URL carries `&refresh=1m`.

**6. DONE** — Dashboard URL read from the browser address bar after the page settled: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afyx3pj4i6xa8d/fwgr63-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m` — UID: `afyx3pj4i6xa8d`.

Final state check on the saved dashboard: breadcrumb title `fwgr63-n1 Bench Dashboard`, panels `fwgr63-n1 Notes` and `fwgr63-n1 Availability`, time range `Last 6 hours`, refresh `1m`, tag `bench`.
